legalBasis: Iepakojuma likums; Dabas resursu nodokļa likums

register.notes: No separate packaging register yet — Elektroregistrs covers WEEE/batteries only. The PPWR-mandated producer register is to be created by 12.02.2027 (KEM: registers within 24 months). Packaging compliance runs through the DRN system + contracts with licensed waste managers.

extraTaxes.name: Dabas resursu nodoklis (DRN) — iepakojums (Annex 7)
extraTaxes.summary: Natural resources tax on packaging placed on the Latvian market (Dabas resursu nodokļa likums, Annex 7 / 7. pielikums, fetched and parsed from likumi.lv 2026-08-16; version in force 15.07.2026). Full official per-material rates (EUR/kg): glass 0.44; wood/paper/cardboard/other natural fibres 0.24; metal 1.10; bioplastic 0.24; plastic (polymer) 1.25; composite carton 1.25; polystyrene 2.20; foam plastic/foam polymer 24.40; foam polystyrene (EPS) 44.00. Composite/laminated packaging is taxed by its predominant material. A contract with a licensed recovery scheme (e.g. LZP, Zaļā josta) exempts the producer from paying DRN at these full statutory rates — that exemption is why scheme membership is the standard route. (Separately in the law body: plastic shopping bags & plastic-containing fishing gear €4.80/kg, wet wipes & balloons €12.20/kg, tobacco filters €8.00/kg — these are plastic-product items, not general packaging.)

notes: pro.rates left null: Latvian recovery schemes (Latvijas Zaļais punkts, Zaļā josta) price their service by contract and publish no public per-material tariff; membershipRequired=false because the legal alternative is paying full DRN (see extraTaxes — the complete official per-material DRN table is now confirmed from likumi.lv). No dedicated packaging producer register exists yet (PPWR-mandated register due by 12.02.2027). verified stays false because there is neither a packaging register to confirm a producer number against nor a public PRO tariff — but the DRN statutory rates that drive the actual cost ARE confirmed from the primary law.
